The '''University of Zo-Ro''' was a [[University/Legends|college]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Colstev]]. It was the site of a [[Massacre of Zo-Ro|massacre]] conducted by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] against the students, who were often dissidents.

[[Jin-Rio Akabi]] survived the massacre, which convinced her to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Behind the scenes==
The University was mentioned in Jin-Rio's Character Folio included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.
